an5.3:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ saupāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā
an5.3:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu assaddho hoti ahiriko hoti anottappī hoti kusīto hoti duppañño hoti
an5.3:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ saupāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā.
an5.3:2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ viharati avighātaṃ anupāyāsaṃ apariḷāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugati pāṭikaṅkhā
an5.3:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti hirīmā hoti ottappī hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti paññavā hoti
an5.3:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ viharati avighātaṃ anupāyāsaṃ apariḷāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugati pāṭikaṅkhāti.
